SystemTable.name: ai_model_config
SystemTable.Create: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `ai_model_config` ( `id` bigint NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `name` varchar(128) NOT NULL COMMENT 'unique model configuration name', `model` varchar(128) NOT NULL COMMENT 'model name for API calls', `provider` varchar(64) NOT NULL COMMENT 'provider: dashscope, openai, custom', `endpoint` varchar(512) NOT NULL COMMENT 'API endpoint', `api_key` varchar(512) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'API key (encrypted)', `model_params` text DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'model parameters in JSON format', `status` varchar(16) DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' COMMENT 'status: ACTIVE, INACTIVE', `description` varchar(1024) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'model description', `gmt_created` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, `gmt_modified` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY (`id`), UNIQUE KEY `uk_name` (`name`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COMMENT='AI model configuration table'

SystemTable.name: ai_function_config
SystemTable.Create: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `ai_function_config` ( `id` bigint NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `function_name` varchar(128) NOT NULL COMMENT 'AI function name (uppercase)', `default_model_name` varchar(128) NOT NULL COMMENT 'default model config name for this function', `gmt_created` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, `gmt_modified` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY (`id`), UNIQUE KEY `uk_function_name` (`function_name`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COMMENT='AI function default model configuration'

SystemTable.name: ai_skill_config
SystemTable.Create: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `ai_skill_config` ( `id` bigint NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `name` varchar(128) NOT NULL COMMENT 'unique skill name', `description` varchar(1024) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'skill description', `prompt` text NOT NULL COMMENT 'skill prompt injected into system prompt', `status` varchar(16) DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' COMMENT 'ACTIVE or INACTIVE', `priority` int DEFAULT 100 COMMENT 'injection order (lower first)', `builtin` tinyint(1) DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '1=built-in, 0=user-defined', `gmt_created` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, `gmt_modified` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY (`id`), UNIQUE KEY `uk_name` (`name`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COMMENT='AI Agent skill configuration'

SystemTable.name: ai_skill_reference
SystemTable.Create: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `ai_skill_reference` ( `id` bigint NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `skill_name` varchar(128) NOT NULL COMMENT 'owning skill name', `ref_name` varchar(128) NOT NULL COMMENT 'reference name', `content` longtext NOT NULL COMMENT 'reference content', `priority` int DEFAULT 100 COMMENT 'display order (lower first)', `gmt_created` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, `gmt_modified` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY (`id`), UNIQUE KEY `uk_skill_ref` (`skill_name`, `ref_name`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COMMENT='AI skill reference documents'
